_recorded: From the October 2026 CVRF document of MSRC (DocumentTitle 'October 2026 Security Updates'), downloaded from https://api.msrc.microsoft.com/cvrf/v3.0/cvrf/2026-Oct on 2026-10-17. Three Vulnerability entries verbatim: CVE-2026-102187, CVE-2026-102192, CVE-2026-100209 (a Windows Kernel CVE affecting Windows 11 Version 26H2, remediated by KB 5127648; a Windows CVE affecting Windows Server only; an Office/SharePoint CVE). ProductTree keeps FullProductName for the products these entries name, verbatim; its Branch is left out, every product in it is also in FullProductName.

FullProductName.Value: Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise for 32-bit Systems
Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise for 64-bit Systems

Notes.Title: Description
Notes.Value: Use of uninitialized resource in Windows Kernel allows an authorized attacker to disclose information locally.

Notes.Title: FAQ
Notes.Value:
What type of information could be disclosed by this vulnerability?

An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could disclose uninitialized heap memory from a privileged process.

Description.Value: Publicly Disclosed:No;Exploited:No;Latest Software Release:Exploitation Less Likely

Title.Value: Windows Failover Cluster Denial of Service Vulnerability

Notes.Title: Description
Notes.Value: Integer underflow (wrap or wraparound) in Windows Failover Cluster allows an unauthorized attacker to deny service over a network.

Description.Value: Publicly Disclosed:No;Exploited:No;Latest Software Release:Exploitation Less Likely

Title.Value: Microsoft Office Excel Remote Code Execution Vulnerability

Notes.Title: Description
Notes.Value: Use after free in Microsoft Office Excel allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.

Notes.Title: FAQ
Notes.Value:
Is the Preview Pane an attack vector for this vulnerability?

No, the Preview Pane is not an attack vector.

Notes.Title: FAQ
Notes.Value:
Are the updates for Microsoft Office LTSC for Mac 2021 and 2024 currently available?

Yes. As of October 15, 2025, the security update for Microsoft Office LTSC for Mac 2021, 2024 and Microsoft Office 365 for Mac are available. Customers running Microsoft Office LTSC for Mac 2021, 2024 and Microsoft Office 365 for Mac should ensure the update is installed to be protected from this vulnerability.

Notes.Title: FAQ
Notes.Value:
According to the CVSS metric, user interaction is required (UI:R). What interaction would the user have to do?

An attacker must send a user a malicious Office file and convince them to open it.

Description.Value: Publicly Disclosed:No;Exploited:No;Latest Software Release:Exploitation Less Likely

Microsoft is announcing the availability of the security updates for Microsoft Office for Mac. Customers running affected Mac software should install the update for their product to be protected from this vulnerability. Customers running other Microsoft Office software do not need to take any action. See the Release Notes for more information and download links.
